taxYears.label: FY 2025–26 (AY 2026–27)

ltcgExemption.description: LTCG on listed equity up to ₹1.25 lakh per year is exempt (Section 112A)

notes: Rates apply to transfers on or after 23 July 2024 (Finance (No. 2) Act 2024).
Indexation benefit has been removed for transfers on or after 23 July 2024.
Crypto/VDA gains are taxed at a flat 30% regardless of holding period; losses cannot be offset against other income.
Short-term gains on non-equity assets are taxed at your applicable slab rate.

taxYears.label: FY 2024–25 (AY 2025–26)

ltcgExemption.description: LTCG on listed equity up to ₹1.25 lakh per year is exempt (Section 112A)

notes: Rates apply to transfers on or after 23 July 2024 (Finance (No. 2) Act 2024). Transfers before that date used 10% LTCG / 15% STCG with a ₹1 lakh exemption and are not modelled here.
Crypto/VDA gains are taxed at a flat 30% regardless of holding period.
Short-term gains on non-equity assets are taxed at your applicable slab rate.
